tool_signatures.name: compareTraces
tool_signatures.description:
Compare the span structure of two traces side-by-side. Matches spans by
(operationName, serviceName, parentOperation) tuple rather than span ID.
Reports added spans, removed spans, and changed spans with duration deltas.

Corresponds to the `jaeger_compare_traces` MCP tool.

parameters.description: Hex-encoded baseline trace ID

parameters.name: comparison_trace_id
parameters.description: Hex-encoded comparison trace ID

tool_signatures.name: jaeger_search_traces
tool_signatures.description: Search Jaeger traces with rich filters.

service.description: Service name to search traces for (required). Use jaeger_list_services to discover valid names.

operation.description: Operation name filter (optional). Use jaeger_list_operations to discover valid names. Example: 'GET /api/orders' or 'grpc.health.v1.Health/Check'.

tags.description: JSON string of tag key-value pairs to filter by (optional). Example: '{"http.status_code":"500"}' to find 5xx errors, or '{"error":"true"}' for any error spans.

start.description: Start time in microseconds since Unix epoch UTC (optional). Example: 1713400000000000 for 2024-04-18 00:00:00 UTC.

end.description: End time in microseconds since Unix epoch UTC (optional). If omitted and start is set, defaults to now.

min_duration.description: Minimum trace duration filter (optional). Format: '100ms', '1.5s', '2m'. Use to find slow traces.

max_duration.description: Maximum trace duration filter (optional). Format: '100ms', '500ms'. Use to find fast traces or exclude outliers.

limit.description: Maximum number of traces to return (1-1500, default 20).
